lines.en: label saradate1:
I guess it wouldn’t hurt to give Sara a call.
lines.zh: 我想，给 Sara 打个电话也没什么损失。

lines.en: I’ve been meaning to get to know her a little better, and it’s not like I have anything else planned for the day.
lines.zh: 我一直想多了解她一点，再说我今天本来也没别的安排。

lines.en: I pull my phone out of my pocket and press on her name in my contacts.
lines.zh: 我从口袋里掏出手机，在通讯录里点下她的名字。

lines.en: It rings a few times before she finally decides to answer.
lines.zh: 响了好几声，她才终于决定接起来。

lines.en: : Helloooo? Who's this?
Oh, right. I never gave her my number.
lines.zh: 哦，对。我从没给过她我的号码。

lines.en: I just plugged hers into my phone after she wrote it on a receipt that one night and have been leaving it alone ever since.
lines.zh: 那天晚上她把号码写在收据上，我就这么存进了手机，此后一直没动过。

lines.en: : It’s your daughter’s teacher. What are you up to right now?
lines.zh: : 我是你女儿的老师。你现在在干嘛？

lines.en: : Oh, hey! I was starting to think you’d never call me.
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿！我还以为你永远不会打给我呢。

lines.en: : I’m just setting up the bar right now. Why?
lines.zh: : 我现在正在布置酒吧。怎么了？

lines.en: : I’m looking for something to do and was wondering if you’d want to go out.
lines.zh: : 我在找点事做，想问你要不要出去走走。

lines.en: : Like, now? Tonight?
lines.zh: : 就现在？今晚？

lines.en: : Yeah. But if you have to set up the bar, it’s-
lines.zh: : 对。不过你要是得布置酒吧的话，那——

lines.en: : No no no no! I’d love to hang out. I can just have Sana finish setting up when she gets here.
lines.zh: : 不不不不！我很想出去玩。等 Sana 来了让她把剩下的布置完就行。

lines.en: : I’ll tell her I went out to buy groceries or something.
lines.zh: : 我就跟她说我出去买菜什么的。

lines.en: : Are you sure that’s okay?
lines.zh: : 你确定没问题吗？

lines.en: : Of course! Is there anywhere you’d want to meet?
lines.zh: : 当然！有没有你想在什么地方碰头？

lines.en: : Let’s just walk around the city or something. I’ll text you an address and we can meet there in around an hour.
lines.zh: : 就在城里随便逛逛什么的吧。我把地址发给你，一个小时后在那儿见。

lines.en: : Sounds good! See ya soon~
lines.zh: : 好呀！待会儿见~

lines.en: It is just then that I realize I don’t know the address of any specific place in the city.
lines.zh: 就在这时我才意识到，城里任何一个具体地方的地址我都不知道。

lines.en: I guess I’ll just have to look up a random building and have her meet me there.
lines.zh: 看来我只能随便查一栋楼，让她在那儿等我了。

lines.en: scene black
"I take a few minutes to research notable locations in the urban district of Kumon-mi and,
lines.zh: "我花了几分钟查了查 Kumon-mi 市区里有哪些像样的地方，

lines.en: after finding one rather large looking building, decide on that as our meeting spot."
lines.zh: 最后挑了一栋看起来相当大的楼，决定就把它当作碰头地点。"

lines.en: scene saradate0
I show up in the designated spot before Sara, which is a good sign.
lines.zh: 我比 Sara 先到了约好的地点，这是个好兆头。

lines.en: Obviously, the two of us aren’t formally dating or anything like that, but it still feels good to have done something right by today’s standards.
lines.zh: 当然，我俩又不是正式在交往什么的，但按今天的标准，能做对一件事的感觉还是挺好的。

lines.en: I’ve gotten so used to letting my immoral side take over that small things like showing up on time to a date are all that’s left to make me feel like a good person.
lines.zh: 我已经习惯了让自己不道德的那一边占上风，所以现在只剩下「约会准时到」这种小事，还能让我觉得自己是个好人。

lines.en: And if Sara were a character in an anime, I’m sure she’d be just as impressed as I am with myself right now.
lines.zh: 要是 Sara 是个动漫角色，我敢说她现在一定和我一样对自己佩服得五体投地。

lines.en: scene saradate1
: Hey there, stranger~
lines.zh: : 你好呀，陌生人~

lines.en: : Did I keep you waiting long?
lines.zh: : 让你等很久了吗？

lines.en: This is the part where the guy normally says “No, not at all,” despite arriving half an hour early or something along those lines.
lines.zh: 正常来说，这时候男生都该说「没有，一点也没有」，尽管他其实早到了半个小时之类的。

lines.en: Just, in this case, I really {i}did{/i} just arrive a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: 只不过这次，我是{i}真的{/i}几分钟前才到。

lines.en: : Nah. I just got here myself.
lines.zh: : 没。我自己也是刚到。

lines.en: scene saradate2
: Awe~ You’re not just saying that to make me feel bad about being a little late, are you?
lines.zh: : 哇~ 你不是在故意这么说，好让我因为迟到一会儿而内疚吧？

lines.en: : I’m not. I really did just get here.
lines.zh: : 没有。我真的刚到。

lines.en: : Right, right...
lines.zh: : 是哦，是哦……

lines.en: : Well, I guess I’ll play along if it’ll make you happy.
lines.zh: : 好吧，要是能让你开心，那我就配合一下好了。

lines.en: scene saradate3
sar "Would you, uhh...mind explaining why we’re meeting in front of this place,
lines.zh: sar 「那个……你能不能解释一下，我们为什么约在这个地方前面见面，

lines.en: though? This isn’t really a typical meeting spot."
lines.zh: though？这实在算不上什么常见的碰头地点。」

lines.en: I turn to the side to see that we're in front of the headquarters for some unfamiliar cell phone company.
lines.zh: 我扭头一看，发现我们正站在某家陌生手机公司的总部前面。

lines.en: : Uh...Nothing turns girls on quite like...multi-billion dollar corporations, right?
lines.zh: : 呃……没有什么比……市值几十亿的大企业更能让女生兴奋了吧？

lines.en: scene saradate4
: Woooow. Who is it that spilled the secret to a woman’s heart to you, [saramaster]?
lines.zh: : 哇哦哦。到底是谁把「女人的心」的秘密透露给你的，[saramaster]？

lines.en: : Just something I picked up over the years, Sara.
lines.zh: : 这些年慢慢学会的罢了，Sara。

lines.en: : I can tell. I’m so horny now. Please make love to me beneath the giant 5G banner towering over us.
lines.zh: : 看得出来。我现在好想要。请在我们头顶那面巨大的 5G 广告牌下面和我做爱吧。

lines.en: : I’m afraid I can’t. 5G Causes cancer and I couldn’t possibly do that to someone as beautiful as you.
lines.zh: : 恐怕不行。5G 会致癌，我怎么能对像你这么漂亮的人做这种事。

lines.en: : If it’s for you, [saramaster], I’d let you do me under {i}6G{/i}.
lines.zh: : 如果是为了你，[saramaster]，我愿意让你在 {i}6G{/i} 下面干我。

lines.en: : This is possibly the strangest flirting exchange I’ve ever been involved in. I feel like I should apologize.
lines.zh: 这大概是我参与过的最奇怪的一段调情了。我觉得我该道个歉。

lines.en: scene saradate5
: No! Don’t apologize! That was totally fun.
lines.zh: : 不！别道歉！那超好玩的。

lines.en: : It made me feel [young]again.
lines.zh: : 它让我觉得自己又[young]了。

lines.en: : Aren’t you only like 30? That’s still really young.
lines.zh: : 你不是才三十左右吗？那已经很年轻了。

lines.en: : I guess by mom-standards, yeah. But I’m no [teenager] anymore, that’s for sure.
lines.zh: : 按当妈的标准来看，是啊。但我肯定已经不是[teenager]了。

lines.en: scene saradate6
: So please continue to flirt with me~ I would very much appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 所以请继续跟我调情吧~ 我会非常感激的。

lines.en: : That I can do, Sara. That I can do...
lines.zh: : 这个我行，Sara。这个我行……

lines.en: scene black
The two of us wind up walking around the city for about an hour or so, stopping at a few convenience stores along the way to buy Sara candy.
lines.zh: 我俩就这么在城里逛了差不多一个小时，中途还进了几家便利店给 Sara 买糖。

lines.en: Yes, apparently she really likes candy. And I mean {i}really{/i} likes candy.
lines.zh: 是的，她显然很喜欢糖。我是说，{i}真的{/i}非常喜欢。

lines.en: In fact, she’s almost like a little kid any time we pass a store that sells chocolate.
lines.zh: 事实上，每次路过卖巧克力的店，她都几乎像个小孩一样。

lines.en: I even needed to talk her out of going into a few of them given just how many shops there are around here that sell things like that...
lines.zh: 这一带卖这种东西的店实在太多，我甚至得劝她别进其中几家……

lines.en: scene saradate7
: Wow. We’ve been together almost a full hour and you’re not bored of me yet.
lines.zh: : 哇。我们都待了快一个小时了，你居然还没腻。

lines.en: : Maybe we {i}are{/i} meant to be together after all.
lines.zh: : 说不定我们{i}本来就该{/i}在一起呢。

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
: Well, it’s not like we haven’t already {i}been{/i} together, if you catch my drift.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们又不是没{i}「在一起」{/i}过，你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: scene saradate8
: Not like that, perv! I meant like, you know, as a {i}thing{/i}.
lines.zh: : 不是那种意思，变态！我是说，就是……当成{i}一回事{/i}。

lines.en: : Like...friends with benefits?
lines.zh: : 比如……炮友？

lines.en: : No! Like...
lines.zh: : 不是！就是……

lines.en: : Like I could be your girlfriend. Or something.
lines.zh: : 就是我可以当你女朋友之类的。

lines.en: : This is the first “date” you and I have gone out on and you already want to be my girlfriend?
lines.zh: : 这才是我俩第一次出来「约会」，你就想当我女朋友了？

lines.en: : Doesn’t that seem a little premature?
lines.zh: : 是不是有点太早了？

lines.en: scene saradate9
: Whaaaat? No way! I don’t think so at all.
lines.zh: : 什——么？才没有！我一点都不觉得。

lines.en: : I mean, you seem pretty tolerable of me and stuff. And you’re cute.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你看起来还挺能忍受我的。而且你很可爱。

lines.en: : Sara. Why are you poking my face?
lines.zh: : Sara。你为什么在戳我的脸？

lines.en: scene saradate10
: Oh, and your penis is super big and I don't think I could ever go back to a normal size one now~
lines.zh: : 哦，还有你的鸡巴超级大，我觉得自己再也回不去正常尺寸了~

lines.en: : Sara. Hands. There’s an entire family like ten feet away from us.
lines.zh: : Sara。手。离我们不到三米的地方有一大家子人。

lines.en: scene saradate9
: Sorry. Heheh~
lines.zh: : 抱歉。嘿嘿~

lines.en: : You’re still poking me...
lines.zh: : 你还在戳我……

lines.en: : What’s wrong with a little poking? Am I not allowed to have fun on my day off?
lines.zh: : 戳一下怎么了？我休息日还不能找点乐子吗？

lines.en: : This isn’t your day off. You just pawned work off on your daughter so you could hang out with me.
lines.zh: : 今天不是你的休息日。你只是把活推给女儿，好跟我出来玩。

lines.en: scene saradate11
: And I wouldn’t have done that if I didn’t want you to be my new boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 我要不是想让你当我新男友，才不会这么干呢。

lines.en: Okay, so...I know Sara and I are close to the same age. And dating in our age group is a lot different than it is when you’re a [teenager].
lines.zh: 好吧，这么说来……我知道 Sara 和我年纪差不多。而我们这个年纪的恋爱，和[teenager]的时候完全不一样。

lines.en: But even by those standards, she’s still coming on strong.
lines.zh: 可就算按那个标准，她也还是来得太猛了。

lines.en: Either she’s incredibly lonely, or she just really {i}really{/i} likes me for some reason beyond my comprehension.
lines.zh: 要么她寂寞得要命，要么就是出于某种我无法理解的理由，真的非常{i}非常{/i}喜欢我。

lines.en: : Let’s just...hang out a few more times before committing to anything, okay?
lines.zh: : 我们……再多出来玩几次，之后再定下来，好吗？

lines.en: if sarainterest == True:
: Why?~ Haruka already told me you like me. Don’t you wanna make sure no other handsome teacher can come sweep me away?
lines.zh: : 为什么呀？~ Haruka 都告诉我你喜欢我了。你就不怕别的帅哥老师把我抢走吗？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I’m the only male teacher in the[school], so I don’t think that will be an issue.
lines.zh: : 我敢说我是[school]里唯一的男老师，所以我觉得这不成问题。

lines.en: else:
: Boo~ You’re no fun, [saramaster].
lines.zh: : 切~ 你真无趣，[saramaster]。

lines.en: : I guess if you’re not ready to date, though, that’s fine. I get it.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是还没准备好谈恋爱，那也没关系。我懂。

lines.en: scene saradate12
: We both have other people that are important to us that we should focus on.
lines.zh: : 我们都有各自重要的人需要去专注对待。

lines.en: : I have my daughter...You have your [niece]...
lines.zh: : 我有我的女儿……你有你的 [niece]……

lines.en: : And I can’t imagine they’d feel normal about becoming related all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我也无法想象，他们突然变成亲戚会有什么正常反应。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can’t imagine that e-
lines.zh: : 是啊，我无法想象那——

lines.en: : Wait, related? I thought we were just talking about dating.
lines.zh: : 等等，亲戚？我以为我们只是在说谈恋爱。

lines.en: scene saradate7
: For now. Heheh~
lines.zh: : 目前是。嘿嘿~

lines.en: else:
I think back to when I turned Sara down in her apartment a while back.
lines.zh: 我想起不久前在 Sara 公寓里拒绝她的那次。

lines.en: I still don’t fully understand what it was about that situation that made me say no to her, but...
lines.zh: 我至今没完全弄明白，当时到底是什么让我对她说了不，不过……

lines.en: I can’t help but wonder if that’s had any sort of impact on how she sees me?
lines.zh: 我忍不住想知道，那件事有没有影响到她对我的看法？

lines.en: Judging by the flow of the conversation so far, it certainly doesn’t feel that way.
lines.zh: 从目前对话的走向来看，显然没有。

lines.en: But...oh well. I guess it’s just part of human nature to wonder about things like this.
lines.zh: 不过……算了。我想，会去琢磨这种事也是人之常情。

lines.en: I’m sure it’s no big deal.
lines.zh: 我确信这没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’d even want to date someone like me?
lines.zh: : 你真的确定，你会想和我这样的人谈恋爱吗？

lines.en: scene saradate13
: Are you sure you {i}wouldn’t{/i} want to date someone like me?
lines.zh: : 你真的确定，你{i}不想{/i}和我这样的人谈恋爱吗？

lines.en: : Because if you’re thinking I’m the type who just throws herself at everyone...I’m really not.
lines.zh: : 因为如果你觉得我是那种见谁就扑上去的女人……我真的不是。

lines.en: : I just...kind of feel comfortable with you for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我只是……不知道为什么，跟你在一起很放松。

lines.en: scene saradate14
sar "But I know you’re not realistically thinking of me that way, so we can just move on. I’m
lines.zh: sar 「不过我知道，你实际上并没有那样看我，所以我们跳过这个话题吧。我

lines.en: sorry for taking the joke too far."
lines.zh: sorry，是玩笑开过头了。」

lines.en: scene saradate14
: Um, all that stuff aside, I’ve actually been wondering something lately.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那些先不说，我最近其实一直在想一件事。

lines.en: : You know how you’ve been coming to the bar a lot?
lines.zh: : 你知道你最近老是来酒吧吧？

lines.en: : Is there anything you think I should be doing that I’m not already doing?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我有没有什么该做、却还没做的事？

lines.en: : The place is going downhill fast and I’m not really sure how long I can keep going at this rate.
lines.zh: : 这地方衰落得很快，我真不知道照这个速度还能撑多久。

lines.en: : What makes you think I know anything about running a bar?
lines.zh: : 你凭什么觉得我懂怎么经营酒吧？

lines.en: sar "Nothing at all! But from a customer’s perspective, you seem to keep coming back. And
lines.zh: sar 「完全没有！但从顾客的角度来看，你好像一直会回来。而且

lines.en: I doubt it’s just because of my daughter and me."
lines.zh: 我怀疑不只是因为我和我女儿。」

lines.en: scene saradate15
: Wait a second! It {i}is{/i} because of my daughter and me!
lines.zh: : 等等！{i}就是{/i}因为我和我女儿啊！

lines.en: : I thought that was pretty obvious...
lines.zh: : 我还以为这很明显呢……

lines.en: scene saradate16
: Ugh! I’m doomed after all!
lines.zh: : 啊！我果然完蛋了！

lines.en: : We were fine until all of the men started disappearing, but now it's like we're imploding or something!
lines.zh: : 在那些男人开始消失之前我们还能撑住，可现在简直像是在从内部崩塌！

lines.en: : I can’t rely on our cute faces to keep the place open, can I?!
lines.zh: : 我总不能靠我俩的可爱脸蛋把店撑下去吧？！

lines.en: : I’m sorry to stray away from the topic at hand, but that face makes you look a lot more like Sana than normal.
lines.zh: : 抱歉跑题了，不过你那个表情让你看起来比平时更像 Sana。

lines.en: scene saradate15
: She’s my daughter! Of course we look alike!
lines.zh: : 她是我女儿！当然长得像啊！

lines.en: : Now, back to talking about the bar!
lines.zh: : 好了，回到酒吧的话题！

lines.en: : What should I do to make it better?!
lines.zh: : 我该怎么做才能让它好起来？！

lines.en: s "I am not qualified to answer this question. I’m not even qualified to help
lines.zh: s 「我可没资格回答这个问题。我连帮

lines.en: Sana with her social skills and I’m somehow doing that."
lines.zh: Sana 提高社交能力都不够格，却莫名其妙地正在做这事。」

lines.en: : I’ve pretty much exhausted my ability to help.
lines.zh: : 我基本已经把能帮的都帮完了。

lines.en: scene saradate17
: Well...
: Can you at least keep coming by and spending lots of money then?
lines.zh: : 那你至少能继续常来、多花点钱吧？

lines.en: : Pleeeeeeeease?
lines.zh: : 求——求你了？

lines.en: : I was never going to stop in the first place...
lines.zh: : 我本来也没打算不来……

lines.en: scene saradate18
: Yay! More time with [saramaster] and more money for rent! You’re officially my favorite customer!
lines.zh: : 耶！有更多时间和 [saramaster] 待在一起，还有更多钱交房租！你正式成为我最喜欢的顾客了！

lines.en: : Well, thanks. But at least wait until you have a few more to give me that title. It feels kind of meaningless as-is.
lines.zh: : 谢了。不过至少等你再多几个顾客再给我这个头衔吧。现在给感觉没什么意义。

lines.en: : Nope. Title’s all yours. No refunds. Sorry~
lines.zh: : 不要。头衔归你了。概不退换。抱歉~

lines.en: scene saradate19
"The conversation suddenly comes to a halt as Sara’s excitement turns into a mix between
lines.zh: "对话突然停了下来，Sara 的兴奋变成了一种既像感激、

lines.en: what seems like appreciation and admiration. "
lines.zh: 又像钦佩的东西。"

lines.en: : I had a really good time today.
lines.zh: : 我今天玩得很开心。

lines.en: : We can...do this again, right?
lines.zh: : 我们……可以再来一次，对吧？

lines.en: : I really don't want this to be like...a one time thing.
lines.zh: : 我真的不希望这变成……一次性的事。

lines.en: : Sure. I had fun too.
lines.zh: : 当然。我也玩得很开心。

lines.en: : How about I just call you the next time I’m free and we do something again then?
lines.zh: : 那下次我有空就打给你，我们再出来做点什么，怎么样？

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: Yeah, I’d like that a lot...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我会很期待的……

lines.en: scene black
The two of us get off the bench a few minutes later and begin the journey home.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，我俩从长椅上起身，各自踏上回家的路。

lines.en: We wind up splitting apart near the halfway point so neither of us are forced to walk in the direction opposite our respective homes.
lines.zh: 我们在差不多一半的地方分开，这样谁都不必往自己家相反的方向走。

lines.en: Sara returns to the bar, while I return home to grab a change of clothes and something to eat...
lines.zh: Sara 回酒吧，而我回家拿换洗的衣服和点吃的……

lines.en: All things considered, today was a good day.
